description: FFmpeg 9.0.2 LGPL native libraries for .NET, with HLS and DASH custom I/O support, dav1d (AV1), libjxl (JPEG XL), and common photo formats. Shared libraries for Android, osx-arm64, win-x64 and win-arm64, static archives for iOS ARM64 and browser-wasm, and NativeAOT static libraries for Android, osx-arm64, win-x64 and win-arm64. macOS and Windows include transcoding filters and libopus encoding. Windows includes D3D11VA and Media Foundation support.
